description: This file defines the NoBracketingException class, a custom exception used in the Apache Commons Math library to indicate that function values at both ends of an interval have the same sign, preventing bracketing methods from proceeding.

classes.name: NoBracketingException
classes.description: A specialized exception indicating that the function values at the interval endpoints have the same sign, making bracketing impossible.

methods.name: NoBracketingException(double lo, double hi, double fLo, double fHi)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with interval bounds and function values at those bounds.

methods.name: NoBracketingException(Localizable specific, double lo, double hi, double fLo, double fHi, Object... args)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with additional contextual information.

methods.name: getLo
methods.description: Returns the lower end of the interval.

methods.name: getHi
methods.description: Returns the higher end of the interval.

methods.name: getFLo
methods.description: Returns the function value at the lower end of the interval.

methods.name: getFHi
methods.description: Returns the function value at the higher end of the interval.
